credited_prior_work.scope: The complete quadratic two-index formula, structural dichotomy, and balanced four-value containment are prior results. This package identifies the one-unit defect with torsion and solves binary-field attainment.

local_work: Explicit characteristic-free Cech identification of the recurrence kernel with H0(C,O_C(n,-n)); section/triviality criterion including reduced singular and doubled (1,1) boundaries; elementary all-size F2 attainment criterion and three exact prime-order witnesses.
field_and_hypotheses: The torsion criterion is over any field for a primitive degree-two coefficient triple with no fixed K-rational homogeneous z-root, and balanced source size a>=3. Small-power cohomology matrices T_n are separately defined for every n>=2. The exact rank-set classification is restricted to quadratic-in-z slices over F2.
finite_evidence: All 264 primitive degree-two binary coefficient triples without a fixed F2 root are partitioned into 16 exact PGL2(F2) by PGL2(F2) orbits. Representative profiles and prime-order witness identities are finite corroboration; the all-size proof uses the geometric argument and explicit polynomial identities, not sampled periodicity.
prior_credit: Standard cohomology, curve degree theory, Riemann--Roch, and normalization/Picard sequences retain the cited external attribution. Original source construction and kernel-index results retain their prior local credits. No historical-priority claim is made.
limitations: One balanced crossed biform block and a binary-field attainment classification, not a full cyclic-source classification for a>3, compatible target construction, degeneration, or matrix-multiplication exponent improvement.
